Enabled.title: Multi-factor authentication
Enabled.description: Require a one-time code sent by email, in addition to the password, for every Backoffice sign-in, and for every other password sign-in (storefront, apps, API clients) that names no store or a store that follows this setting. Users without a confirmed email or with lockout disabled can't sign in while the code is required: confirm their email and enable their lockout before turning this on.

StoreMode.title: Multi-factor authentication
StoreMode.description: Whether a password sign-in to this store needs a one-time code sent by email in addition to the password. Use global setting: follow the global multi-factor authentication setting. Enabled: required for every user. Disabled: not required. Admin managed: required only for the users and organizations an administrator set to Required in the Backoffice; customers can't change it. Customer choice: customers turn it on or off for themselves, and organization maintainers with the "xapi:my_organization:mfa:manage" permission for the whole organization; off by default; a Required set by an administrator can't be turned off. The Backoffice sign-in follows only the global setting.

mode.subtitle: Who requires the code at sign-in

description.Off: Not turned on. In stores with Customer choice it can be turned on in the storefront.
description.Enabled: Turned on in the storefront. Counts in stores with Customer choice, where it can also be turned off.
description.Required: Set by the administrator. Counts in stores with Admin managed or Customer choice and can't be turned off in the storefront.
